en: No matter what I eat, I'm never satiated.{SAUT}Is it a sin to feel this way?
It technically is... after all, one of the{SAUT}seven deadly sins is gluttony. I could{SAUT}work that in. "The sweet taste of sin..."
Ooh, is that what you were looking for?
Sweet fruit... No. It needs to sound{SAUT}more tempting... and more toxic...
Yes, that's it! You're pretty good at{SAUT}poetry. Maybe you have secret{SAUT}yearnings of your own...?{PAGE}...The sweet forbidden fruit. Yes{SAUT}indeed, I like the sound of that!
Poisoned apple... Forbidden apple...{SAUT}No, forbidden fruit!{PAGE}...The sweet forbidden fruit. Yes, I like{SAUT}the sound of that!
I dunno, that's more repellent than{SAUT}alluring, isn't it? I want it to sound bad{SAUT}in a good way. Rotten is just... bad.{PAGE}What about "forbidden fruit"? Ooh, I{SAUT}like the sound of that!
Yes... It's a love story with the seven{SAUT}deadly sins. It's about wearing an angelic{SAUT}mask while harboring such dark secrets...
*gasp* NYAAAAAAAH! Was I talking{SAUT}out loud!?{PAGE}This can't be! Please, stop up your ears!{SAUT}Fling such words far away from your{SAUT}memory!
Okay, okay. Calm down. Why don't you{SAUT}just tell me if your poem is finished?
Er, what's a poetic way of saying this?{SAUT}Almost.{PAGE}If I can just get a bit more inspiration,{SAUT}I think I can finish...
If your soul is unfulfilled... then go{SAUT}NORTH, young lass!
Oh, that's right. I heard singing up there.{SAUT}It was deep in an area with a bear FOE...
Yeah, that was definitely up north.{SAUT}Okay, then! Let's go!
